GLASSWARE SUPPLY AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made on 9 March 2027 between Thistlewaite Glassworks Limited ("Supplier") and Orvane Lantern Retail plc ("Retailer").

1. DEFINITIONS
1.1 "Season" means each period of six months beginning on 1 January or 1 July.
1.2 "Products" means the hand-blown lantern globes listed in Schedule 1.

2. SUPPLY
2.1 Supplier shall manufacture and supply the Products to Retailer in the quantities set out in each firm Order.
2.2 Retailer shall not resell the Products outside its own stores without Supplier's written consent.

3. FORECASTS AND ORDERS
3.1 Retailer shall share a rolling non-binding forecast with Supplier on the first Business Day of each month.
3.2 Retailer shall place its forecast at least one hundred and eighty (180) days before the start of each Season and confirm firm Orders at least one hundred and ten (110) days before delivery.
3.3 Supplier shall acknowledge each firm Order within five (5) Business Days.

4. PRICE AND PAYMENT
4.1 The price of each Product is set out in Schedule 1 and is fixed for the first two Seasons.
4.2 Retailer shall pay each invoice within forty (40) days of its date.

5. TERM AND TERMINATION
5.1 This Agreement continues for three (3) years from the date above.
5.2 Either party may terminate this Agreement if the other commits a material breach that is not remedied within twenty (20) days of notice.

6. GENERAL
6.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.

AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO THE GLASSWARE SUPPLY AGREEMENT
This Amendment No. 1 is made on 3 February 2028 between Thistlewaite Glassworks Limited and Orvane Lantern Retail plc.
1. Words defined in the Agreement have the same meaning in this Amendment.
2. Clause 3.2 of the Agreement is deleted in its entirety and replaced with the following:
"3.2 Retailer shall place its forecast at least ninety-five (95) days before the start of each Season and confirm firm Orders at least forty-five (45) days before delivery."
3. Except as amended by this Amendment, the Agreement remains in full force and effect.
